title: Knight-Wallace Fellowships
institution: Wallace House Center for Journalists, University of Michigan
about: Wallace House Center for Journalists at the University of Michigan, United States, is accepting applications for the 2027-2028 Knight-Wallace Fellowships. U.S. journalists apply by 1 February 2027, with references due 7 February; the international applicant deadline is 1 December 2026.
card_alt: Card for the Knight-Wallace Fellowships at Wallace House Center for Journalists, University of Michigan, in Ann Arbor, United States, with a deadline of 1 Feb 2027 for U.S. journalists. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York, not Ann Arbor.
